main.description: A patron's signed proof that a quest was delivered and paid — the OBJECTIVE delivery anchor and the eligibility context for delivery/split attestations. Money settles OFF-protocol (Stripe Connect, #18); this record attests the OUTCOME only and holds NO card data or PII — just opaque settlement ids + amounts. Only escrow-settled quests are reputation-bearing (the collusion tax). Written to the patron's repo.

payee.description: The guild (AT-URI / id) or builder DID that was paid.

party.description: Builder DIDs on the delivering party (grants splits.fair eligibility).

amount.description: Gross amount in minor units (e.g. cents) — integer, never a float. Settled off-protocol; recorded here for the trail.

paymentRef.description: Opaque off-protocol settlement id (e.g. a Stripe transfer id). NEVER card numbers or PII.
